measurement_semantics.wall: Instant enclosing the paired thread-CPU sample; includes timing overhead
measurement_semantics.cpu: CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID; every batch stage, every 257th conversion/ingest; sampled totals are not extrapolated
measurement_semantics.residual: paired wall-minus-CPU, clamped with explicit overlap count; not quota-only wait
measurement_semantics.quota: cpu.stat deltas cover the whole cgroup, not a stage or an isolated consumer
measurement_semantics.allocations: test-only current-thread System call/requested-byte accounting, not RSS or allocator-internal footprint; native live executable has no counting allocator
measurement_semantics.fixed_input: 32768 synthetic two-cookie 64-byte records; 128 independent batches; not kernel evidence; setup and final teardown excluded
measurement_semantics.teardown: separately measured after report construction; includes cached maps, catalog, empty session and latency histogram
measurement_semantics.comparison: sequential same-host runs, not randomized; absolute throughput and RSS can vary with host scheduling and allocation history

optimization.scope: opt-in native validation capture adapter; public PacketMetaFact/export/runtime APIs unchanged

final.difference_from_after: test-only fixture teardown timing added; final-source confirmation campaign passed
